name: Check OpenAPI Spec

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 9 * * 1" # Weekly on Monday at 9am UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  check-spec:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4

      - name: Install the latest version of uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@d0cc045d04ccac9d8b7881df0226f9e82c39688e # v6
        with:
          version: "latest"
          enable-cache: true

      - name: Install just
        # v4
        uses: extractions/setup-just@53165ef7e734c5c07cb06b3c8e7b647c5aa16db3

      - name: Fetch latest spec and regenerate models
        run: just regenerate-models

      - name: Check for differences
        id: diff
        run: |
          if [[ -n "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all -- \
            vantage_sdk/models/gen_models/)" ]]; then
            echo "changed=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "changed=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

      - name: Create pull request
        if: steps.diff.outputs.changed == 'true'
        # v7
        uses: >-
          peter-evans/create-pull-request@271a8d0340265f705b14b6d32b9829c1cb33d45e
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: >-
            feat(models): update OpenAPI spec and regenerate models
          title: "feat(models): update OpenAPI spec and regenerate models"
          body: |
            Regenerate the SDK models from the latest Vantage OpenAPI spec.

            Review the generated model changes before merging.
            The default `feat(models):` classification requests a minor release.
            For breaking changes, add a `feat(models)!:` commit with a
            `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer before merging.
          branch: chore/update-openapi-spec
          signoff: true
          delete-branch: true

name: Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: '*'

jobs:
  python-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4

    - name: Install the latest version of uv
      uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@d0cc045d04ccac9d8b7881df0226f9e82c39688e # v6
      with:
        version: "latest"
        enable-cache: true

    - name: Install Python versions
      run: uv python install 3.11 3.12 3.13

    - name: Run Nox
      env:
        VANTAGE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.VANTAGE_API_KEY }}
        WORKSPACE_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.WORKSPACE_TOKEN }}
      run: uv run nox

    - name: Test build
      run: uv build
